sources.entry: DevProjex - Cross-platform macOS codebase-context app for Intel and Apple Silicon, with GUI, TUI, CLI, live preview, redaction, and a built-in read-only MCP server.

summary.one_liner: DevProjex is a cross-platform desktop, terminal, CLI, and read-only MCP server that turns folders or Git repositories into token-efficient, secret-masked context for AI chats and coding agents.
summary.what_it_does: Lets you pick files and folders in a tree, preview the result with line, character, and token counters, and export it as ASCII, Markdown, JSON, or XML to a file or clipboard. It can also export a masked copy of a project as a folder or ZIP. Smart Ignore hides build output and dependency folders only when it finds evidence, and Git modes limit the view to tracked, staged, changed, or ref-to-ref diff files. Hide Secrets masks detected credentials in place using a pinned Gitleaks rule set, and an optional switch masks emails, IPs, user paths, and similar private data. Code compression keeps signatures and empties function bodies, and comment stripping covers 20 language packs via Tree-sitter. The built-in MCP server exposes eight read-only tools (tree, search, file reads, related files, pack, read pack) with masking always on, and a Live Context mode where the files ticked in the desktop app become the agent's focus. A local agent journal records session metadata without file bodies.
use_cases: Prepare project context for ChatGPT or Claude
Give Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor read-only access to a project
Fail a CI build when secrets would leak into packed context
Export a masked copy of a project as a ZIP
Analyze repository files, lines, and token counts from the command line
Share only selected modules or files for code review
how_to_run: claude mcp add devprojex -- npx -y devprojex mcp --root /absolute/path/to/project
notable: One shared engine, filters, and masking pipeline across the desktop app, Terminal Workspace, CLI, and MCP server
Live Context: ticks in the desktop app become the agent's focus on its next call
Secret masking in MCP mode has no off switch
Agent journal logs session metadata and masked-value counts, never file bodies
Code compression keeps declarations and empties bodies, about 3x smaller on C# sources per the README
caveats: Secret detection is heuristic; the README says to review packs before publishing them outside your environment
The desktop app is not included in the npm and NuGet packages, which provide only the CLI, Terminal Workspace, and MCP server
Project copies with masking enabled are intentionally not byte-for-byte and may not build or run
Requires .NET 10 SDK to run via dnx or to build from source; Node.js 20+ for npx
